fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Sales (reduced under Standard Incentive: 1%/1.5%/2%/2.5%/5% over first 5 years). Brand fee/SBF contribution: 0.90% of Gross Sales. Advertising cooperative/SMF: 3.25% minimum for Traditional Drive-Ins, 1.625% minimum for Non-Traditional and C-Store locations. Inspire Payment Services: ~$365-$565/month. Standard Incentive reduces royalty significantly for new Traditional Restaurants signed by March 31, 2027.
raw_excerpt: Royalty fee 5% of Gross Sales. Brand fee/SBF contribution 0.90% of Gross Sales. Advertising cooperative fee/SMF contribution 1.625% (Minimum) of Gross Sales for Non-Traditional Locations and Non-Drive-In Locations that are C-Stores. Otherwise, 3.25% (Minimum) of Gross Sales.
